cards.audioText: What factors would you consider if you encountered heavy rain during approach?
cards.audioTextZh: 进近过程中遇到大雨时，你会考虑哪些因素？
cards.referenceText: I would consider the reduced visibility, engine performance, runway condition, and reported braking action. I would also assess the risk of a runway overrun on a wet surface. If I did not have the required visual reference at the minimum, I would go around.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我会考虑能见度降低、发动机性能、跑道状况和报告的制动作用，也会评估湿跑道冲出风险。如果在最低标准处没有取得所需目视参考，我会复飞。

cards.audioText: Have you ever flown in heavy rain?
cards.audioTextZh: 你曾在大雨中飞行过吗？
cards.referenceText: Yes, I have flown through heavy rain during an approach. I used the windshield wipers, monitored visibility and runway braking action, and adjusted the approach speed in accordance with the procedure. Although visibility was reduced and the landing distance increased, I maintained a stable approach and landed safely.
cards.referenceTextZh: 是的，我曾在进近期间穿过强降雨。我使用风挡雨刷，监控能见度和跑道制动作用，并按照程序调整进近速度。虽然能见度降低、着陆距离增加，我仍保持稳定进近并安全着陆。

cards.audioText: How can heavy rain affect a flight?
cards.referenceText: Heavy rain can reduce visibility and obscure the windshield. It can reduce runway braking action and increase the risk of an overrun or runway excursion. It may also affect engine performance and aircraft stability during approach.
cards.referenceTextZh: 强降雨会降低能见度并遮蔽风挡，降低跑道制动作用，并增加冲出或偏出跑道的风险。它还可能影响进近期间的发动机性能和飞机稳定性。
